measurement_correction.problem: Path.rglob can silently omit unreadable directories; a mode0300 directory permits known-child writes while its parent timestamps stay unchanged. Actual counter demonstrates the old snapshot can remain equal despite changed file bytes.
measurement_correction.solution: Descriptor-relative explicit scandir/stat/open traversal propagates enumeration failures, records literal link text without resolving targets, rejects non-directory roots, and checks file/directory identities around reads. Component validation and archive policies are unchanged.
